fields.why: Paxlovid treatment is compared across 5 race groups (Table 2) and set out across 4 age groups in the text.
Race (5 groups) and age (20-49, 50-64, 65-79, >=80) qualify; ethnicity and sex are 2 groups each.

Race: Pearson chi-square tests and differences compare each minority group with White only (Table 2 note). Age: the four percentages are only listed; the chi-square tests are race contrasts within age strata, not tests across age (rule 6), so the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
